div.div:
• id: line = SSE event id (hermes-webui resume pattern)
• event: delta for streamed text, tool for tool events,
completed/interrupted/failed for turn endings
• data: JSON payload the frontend renders
• token_count/budget surface the context meter
(assembler snapshot → module 03)
• the same log replays fully for a fresh client
